templates.source: Axis VAPIX Stream Profiles API — https://developer.axis.com/vapix/network-video/stream-profiles/ ; Video Streaming API — https://developer.axis.com/vapix/network-video/video-streaming/
templates.note: Axis does not expose a separate fixed RTSP path for sub/secondary streams. Lower-resolution or secondary streams are accessed via the same /axis-media/media.amp path with a named stream profile (e.g. streamprofile=Bandwidth) or explicit params (resolution=640x480&fps=5). NVRs/VMS systems configure this as a second RTSP request with different query params.

notes: Axis uses a single RTSP endpoint /axis-media/media.amp (VAPIX) for all stream qualities; main vs sub distinction is achieved via query parameters (resolution, fps, compression, videocodec) or named stream profiles (?streamprofile=<name>). Default RTSP port is 554. Default VAPIX username is 'root'. For multi-sensor/multi-channel encoders, use ?camera=<N> to select the input channel. SSM (source-specific multicast) uses /axis-media/ssm/media.amp. The /onvif-media/media.amp path is a separate ONVIF-compliant endpoint requiring a dedicated ONVIF user.
